description: A 2-axis thermal accelerometer in a 6-pin DIP-style module. X and Y are digital pulse outputs whose width changes with tilt (about 5 ms each at level).
how_to_use: Straddle the breadboard gap. Pin 1 Tout (temperature, unused), 2 Yout, 3 GND, 4 GND (the two GND pins are joined inside), 5 Xout, 6 Vdd (5 V). Read the tilt with pulseIn() on the pins wired to Xout and Yout.

plain.what: Senses tilt in two directions and tells the Arduino with pulses.
plain.how: Put it across the middle gap. Vdd to 5V, both GNDs to GND, Xout and Yout to two digital pins.
